scope: Actual controlled read-only interstellar trip/route economics queries: every source planet, generated and baseline environments, three difficulties, independent finite logistics effects, integer infinite boundaries, direct/preferred/required relay policies, budgets1..4, hub priority/ties/unlocked state and integer vessel counts. Station pieces are separately funded and actually placed; gas-planet inputs relocate a paid home piece solely for the query. This is not a placement, earned-growth, dispatched route, throughput or legal-save claim. Source mode-transition/elevator hub handling is captured without adapting source outputs.
